{{Quote|This is Toluz Cheq in the Rial Kroon system. My Padawan is dead, my fleet is destroyed, and I have no means of escape. This is my final report.|Toluz Cheq|<ref name="Hero1" />}}
An individual was the '''Padawan''' of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Toluz Cheq]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Hero1" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HotC date" /> Cheq's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] was [[Battle of the Rial Kroon system|attacked]] in the [[Rial Kroon system/Legends|Rial Kroon system]] by modified [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]]. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the ensuing battle, during which the entire fleet was decimated. Shortly after the Padawan's death, Cheq was killed as well, although he managed to transmit the data on the new enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] before his death.<ref name="Hero1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Padawan was mentioned in the [[The Clone Wars 10|tenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Hero1" /> on [[November 11]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-241/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-10----Hero-of-the-Confederacy-part-1|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #10 &mdash; Hero of the Confederacy part 1}}</ref>
